 Release Date Confirmed For Akshay's Alien Film Samuk
 Mon, 16 November 2026 
 Share: 
 12:53 
 Akshay Kumar in Samuk 
 Akshay Kumar is reuniting with Director Vipul Shah for Samuk , whose release date was recently confirmed by the actor with a brief teaser. The film is set to arrive in theatres on May 28, 2027. 
The actor previously collaborated with Shah on Aankhen, Waqt: The Race Against Time, Namastey London and Action Replayy . Samuk promises to be a very different experience.  
 Touted as a sci-fi action flick, it features Akshay as a commando forced to take on a murderous alien, with the premise possibly drawing inspiration from Arnold Schwarzenegger 's cult hit Predator . 
The film also stars Rukmini Maitr, Raja Kapoor, Vineet Kumar Singh, Banita Sandhu, Sushant Singh and Swanand Kirkire . The team recently completed a lengthy schedule in the UK, with the final leg of the shoot having commenced in Mumbai.
